error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "RA Contention Resolution timer expired for UE 0xa67e, RA procedure failed..." and later "RA Contention Resolution timer expired for UE 0xd3a8, RA procedure failed..."

Context: These errors occur in the NR_MAC module indicating that the Random Access (RA) procedure failed due to the contention resolution timer expiring for two different UEs. This failure prevents successful UE connection establishment and would critically impact system operation.
